branch_assignments.rationale: Interactive neural simulator and data engine from captured worlds.
Action-conditioned dexterous world model for policy rollouts.
Spatial/dynamics-aware VLA with executable manipulation actions.
Native video-action foundation model for closed-loop robot control.

paper.title: Image2Sim: Scaling Embodied Navigation via Generative Neural Simulator
paper.data: Nearly 20K interactive scenes and more than 10M generated navigation samples from posed RGB-D imagery.
paper.method: Feature-Gaussian anchoring plus geometry-aware one-step panoramic RGB-D rendering, motion simulation, and automatic action/instruction annotation.
paper.task: Build real-time interactive neural navigation environments and scalable training data from captured imagery.
paper.novelty: Decouples 3D spatial anchoring from photorealistic observation synthesis to turn image collections into executable simulators.
paper.project_relevance: Direct baseline for image-to-interactive-world generation, navigability, and action-aligned data creation.

paper.title: Mask2Real-WM: Segmentation Masks as a Sim-to-Real Bridge for Controllable Dexterous World Models
paper.data: More than 50 hours of IsaacLab simulation and fewer than 2.5 hours of real dexterous demonstrations.
paper.method: Mask-space dynamics prediction from 23-DoF actions followed by ControlNet-augmented photorealistic video rendering.
paper.task: Action-conditioned long-horizon prediction and policy evaluation for dexterous manipulation.
paper.novelty: Uses segmentation masks as a low-gap sim-to-real dynamics interface that preserves fine-grained joint controllability.
paper.project_relevance: Direct design and evaluation reference for controllable physical-world rollouts.

paper.title: Lift3D-VLA: Lifting VLA Models to 3D Geometry and Dynamics-Aware Manipulation
paper.data: 22 simulated MetaWorld/RLBench tasks and eight Franka real-world tasks with RGB-D/point-cloud observations.
paper.method: 3D-to-2D positional alignment, geometry-centric current/future point-cloud pretraining, and layer-wise temporal action modeling.
paper.task: Geometry- and dynamics-aware language-conditioned robot manipulation.
paper.novelty: Directly encodes point clouds with a pretrained 2D encoder while forecasting future geometry and structured action chunks.
paper.project_relevance: Strong baseline linking spatial state evolution to executable VLA actions.

paper.title: Native Video-Action Pretraining for Generalizable Robot Control
paper.data: Large-scale video-action pretraining corpus plus simulation and real-robot manipulation evaluations reported by the authors.
paper.method: Semantic visual-action tokenizer, native causal pretraining, sparse MoE backbone, and asynchronous closed-loop forward-dynamics inference.
paper.task: Generalizable real-time robot control through joint video and action prediction.
paper.novelty: Builds the video-action stack from scratch for embodiment rather than retrofitting a bidirectional reconstruction video generator.
paper.project_relevance: Field-shaping reference for predictive dynamics, action generation, latency, and observation re-grounding in one control loop.
